{{Quote|Do I know Luke Skywalker? Of course I know him! Well, I mean, I've never met him, but ''everybody'' knows Luke Skywalker. He defeated the Emperor, and they say he's the best star pilot in the galaxy.|Jessika Pava, to C-3PO|<ref name="Weapon of a Jedi" />}}
'''Jessika Pava''', also known as '''Jess''' or '''Testor''', as well as the '''Great Destroyer''' by [[droid]]s, was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[pilot]] of the [[Resistance]] during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. A [[Homeworld|native]] of the [[planet]] [[Dandoran]], Pava was [[Reproduction|born]] in a [[time]] when the [[New Republic]] [[New Republic Era|governed]] [[the galaxy]], restoring [[democracy]] after [[Standard decade|decades]] of [[Imperial Era|totalitarian rule]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]. Raised on the legends of [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]], Pava was a great admirer of the [[Jedi]] who [[Battle of Endor|defeated]] [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] and became known as the best [[star]] pilot in [[Galaxy|galactic]] [[Timeline of galactic history|history]].

Following in her idol's example, Pava became a [[New Republic pilot|pilot]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]]. However, in lieu of the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate's]] unwillingness to punish the First Order's violations of the [[Galactic Concordance|peace treaty]] that ended the [[Galactic Civil War]], Pava chose to support [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa's]] organization as a [[Resistance pilot]] during the [[Cold War]]. Serving as a member of [[Blue Squadron (Resistance)|Blue Squadron]] and [[Black Squadron (Resistance)|Black Squadron]], in turn, she piloted the [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] under the command of [[Commander]] [[Poe Dameron]].

Pava served with distinction during her time in the Resistance, although the group's [[Astromech droid|astromech units]] took note of her record for losing droids while on missions for the Resistance. In the aftermath of the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]] in [[34 ABY]], Pava's [[squadron]] deployed to [[Starkiller Base]] in an attempt to destroy the [[superweapon]] before it could destroy the [[Resistance base]] along with the entire planet of [[D'Qar]]. Their [[Battle of Starkiller Base|mission]] was ultimately a success, resulting in the base's destruction and the survival of the Resistance.

==Biography==
===Early life===
[[File:JessikaPavasBadMemories-PoeDameron19.png|thumb|left|200px|Young Jessika and her family are captured by pirates.]]
Jessika Pava was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]]<ref name="Weapon of a Jedi" /> [[Reproduction|born]] to [[parent]]s<ref name="USWNE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> at some point after [[2 ABY]]<ref name="Pava date" /> who [[Homeworld|came]] from<ref name="TFA NA" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="DB">{{Databank|dandoran|Dandoran}}</ref> [[Dandoran]].<ref name="TFA NA" /> During her childhood on Dandoran, Pava and her family were captured by [[pirate]]s and sold into [[slavery]].<ref name="USWNE" /> This led her to want to be in control and a hatred of being chained up later in life.<ref name="Poe Dameron 16">[[Poe Dameron 16|''Poe Dameron'' 16]]</ref>

As a girl, she idolized the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] hero [[Luke Skywalker]]<ref name="USWNE" /> and regarded him as the greatest [[pilot]] in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Weapon of a Jedi" /> This admiration led her to follow in Skywalker's footsteps and join the [[Resistance]].<ref name="USWNE" /> Although Pava didn't initially score high enough on the live-fire tests, [[Temmin Wexley]] used his influence to ensure that Pava could get her the time and focus that would eventually let her become a pilot.<ref name="Eulogy for Snap">{{StoryCite|story=A Eulogy for Snap|book=Star Wars (2020) 25}}</ref>

===Cold war===
====Serving the Resistance====
Pava became a member of the [[Resistance]] during its [[Cold War|conflict]] with the [[First Order]],<ref name="Weapon of a Jedi" /> approximately thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]].<ref name="PD1" /> She flew as a [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] in [[Blue Squadron (Resistance)|Blue Squadron]], operating under the [[callsign]] of [[Blue Three]]. She was an admirer of Luke Skywalker, the famed [[Jedi Knight]] who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the [[Galactic Civil War]], and had heard stories of his [[time]] in the Rebellion, such as when he destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Weapon of a Jedi" />

While performing a maintenance assignment while serving at a [[Resistance base]], Pava met [[C-3PO]], a [[protocol droid]] who had been in the service of Skywalker and the Rebellion during the Galactic Civil War. Upon realizing that Threepio knew Skywalker, she asked him to tell her a story about Skywalker's adventures during the war. Threepio regaled her with a story of Skywalker's [[Skirmish in the Temple of Eedit|time]] on [[Devaron]] after the Battle of [[Yavin Prime|Yavin]], where he [[Jedi training|trained]] in the [[Jedi]] [[Temple of Eedit]]. Her time talking to Threepio was cut short, once Pava was called to a meeting in the Resistance command center.<ref name="Weapon of a Jedi" />

====Mission to Ovanis====
[[File:BlackSquadronAssembled-PoeDameron1.png|thumb|right|250px|Pava and her fellow Black Squadron pilots prior to the Ovanis mission]]
As a friend of [[Captain]] [[Poe Dameron]] and a member of [[Black Squadron (Resistance)|Black Squadron]], Pava was handpicked by Dameron for a [[Hunt for Lor San Tekka|secret quest]] to find the explorer [[Lor San Tekka]]. [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] had tasked Dameron with finding Lor San Tekka in the hope of finding her lost brother Luke. Pava was also accompanied by the Galactic Civil War veterans [[L'ulo L'ampar]] and [[Temmin Wexley]] ("Snap"), and the pilot [[Karé Kun]]. Prior to departing, Pava told Dameron that she had to delay her repairs to her T-70 [[X-wing starfighter]] and asked about the details of their mission. Dameron apologized that their mission was classified for now.<ref name="PD1" />

For their [[Mission to Ovanis|first mission]], Pava and her team traveled to the [[mountain]]ous world of [[Ovanis]]. Ovanis was home to a cult called the [[Crèche]], who were believed to have encountered San Tekka. While Dameron and [[BB-8]] flew their [[Black One|X-wing]] into the [[Cave of the Crèche]] to question the Crèche cultists, Pava and her fellow pilots circled the skies. After initiating contact with the Crèche, Dameron contacted L'ulo to warn them that he had found a [[Homing beacon|tracker]] on his [[starfighter]]. Kun then reported the presence of a [[First Order landing platform]] and other [[First Order military|forces]] hovering above the [[Cave]] of the Crèche.<ref name="PD1" />

Following the arrival of First Order forces, Pava asked her fellow pilots what Dameron had meant by his order "get me some leverage." At L'ulo and Kun's recommendation, the pilots decided to figure it out for themselves. Wexley advocated seizing the First Order platform so that they could land and [[Fuel|refuel]] their starfighters. Pava then proposed getting rid of the [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter]]s so that they could land. She believed that the ground forces on the platform would surrender right away. L'ulo then used his [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|A-wing]] to strafe the [[TIE series|TIE fighters]] but was unable to destroy them all. The surviving TIE fighters engaged [[Color|Black]] [[Squadron]] in a dogfight.<ref name="PD2">[[Poe Dameron 2|''Poe Dameron'' 2]]</ref>

However, the First Order commander [[Agent]] [[Terex]] had kept back the [[Maxima-A-class heavy cruiser|Maxima-A class heavy cruiser]] ''[[Ravenous]]'' and its TIE fighter complement in reserve. Black Squadron soon found itself pursued by several TIE fighters.<ref name="PD2" /> Outnumbered and outgunned, Pava remarked that they had to get out of the line of [[fire]]. When L'ulo recommended buying them time for Dameron, Wexley ordered his pilots to split up and head into the canyons in an attempt to disperse their pursuers. Pava found herself pursued by three TIE fighters but managed to lose them by collapsing a ridge on top of them. However, her [[astromech droid]] was hit by two other TIE fighters. At Wexley's recommendation, Pava and her fellow pilots launched a head-on attack on the TIE fighters.<ref name="PD3">[[Poe Dameron 3|''Poe Dameron'' 3]]</ref>

During the dogfight, Pava and her fellow pilots witnessed two large winged [[Unidentified Crèche creature|creatures]] fighting above the Cave of the Crèche. The dark-winged creature ultimately triumphed over the blue-winged creature. When Dameron turned the tables on Terex and his ground forces, he managed to force the [[First Order Security Bureau]] Agent to withdraw his TIE fighters. This enabled Black Squadron to land at the Cave of the Crèche and refuel their starfighters. After the Crèche cultists had departed on the black-winged creature, Black Squadron departed. Dameron then radioed for Terex's [[cruiser]] ''Ravenous'' to pick up the stranded First Order forces. Dameron had decided not to take Terex into custody to avoid provoking war between the First Order and the [[New Republic]].<ref name="PD3" />

====Mission to Megalox Beta====
Following the mission to Ovanis, Pava and her fellow pilots returned to the base on [[D'Qar]] where they celebrated with drinks. Pava took the opportunity to chat with the [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Oddy Muva]]. She thanked him for installing the new boosters on her X-wing fighter. When Muva wished that he could have seen action, Pava reassured him that he would get his turn once the Resistance obtained more starfighters from the New Republic. Muva thanked her. Pava then told Muva that Dameron was planning to take the squadron on another mission. When Muva asked about the mission, Pava admitted that she did not know but recalled that Dameron had mentioned a [[prison]]. The two then shared drinks.<ref name="PD4">[[Poe Dameron 4|''Poe Dameron'' 4]]</ref>

For their [[Mission to Megalox Beta|next mission]], Black Squadron traveled to [[Megalox]] prison on the planet [[Megalox Beta]]. Dameron wanted to question [[Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi|Grakkus]] the [[Hutt]], who was an inmate at the prison. Megalox was considered to be one of the roughest prisons for the worst criminals. The prison was surrounded by a [[gravity]] field that was projected by an [[orbit]]ing [[Megalox space station|space station]]. Upon arriving, Black Squadron was greeted by [[Warden]] [[Luta]], who had been bribed by Organa into letting her pilots visit the prison. Luta's prison guards transported Pava and her comrades on a [[shuttle]] into the prison.<ref name="PD4" />

[[File:JessikaPava-PoeDameron19.png|thumb|left|160px|Pava without her helmet]]
However, the guards then abandoned them at the landing port. Pava and her fellow pilots were forced to fight their way through the crowd to [[Fortress of Grakkus the Hutt|Grakkus' fortress]]. After arriving, they were accosted by Grakkus and his Hutt [[Grakks|posse]], who allowed Dameron to enter Grakkus' quarters. While Dameron met with Grakkus, Pava and the others waited in the courtyard. Since Terex had already arrived, Grakkus offered to reveal the information to whoever could free him from the prison.<ref name="PD4" /> Pava and her fellow pilots were shocked to see Terex but allowed him to leave the [[fortress]].<ref name="PD5">[[Poe Dameron 5|''Poe Dameron'' 5]]</ref>

Shortly later, Dameron exited Grakkus' quarters and briefed the squadron about their change in plans. In order to extract leverage, Dameron ordered BB-8 and the other astromech [[droid]]s to disable Megalox's gravity shield. Pava's astromech droid [[O-R10N]] took part in the operation but was destroyed by a [[Unidentified Megalox droid|security droid]]. While waiting, Pava expressed frustration that she did not have a [[Starship|ship]] or weapons. Dameron expressed empathy for her predicament but promised that they would get back in action soon. At that point, Terex returned with an [[army]] of [[gangster]]s that he had recruited to storm the fortress and [[Death|kill]] Grakkus' guards and Black Squadron.<ref name="PD5" />

When the mob breached the gates, Pava and her fellow pilots joined the Hutts in fighting off the gangsters.<ref name="PD5" /> As the crowd surged, Dameron told his Squadron to fall back but Pava countered that Grakkus had sealed his gates. Black Squadron gathered outside the door to Grakkus' house. Shortly later, BB-8 contacted Dameron to inform them that the gravity shield had been deactivated. Under Dameron's orders, Pava and the others donned their [[gravity belt]]s. With the gangsters incapacitated by Megalox Beta's gravity, Black Squadron rescued Grakkus.<ref name="PD6">[[Poe Dameron 6|''Poe Dameron'' 6]]</ref>

After Dameron contacted Luta and secured a deal to leave the prison with Grakkus, Pava and her fellow pilots returned to the [[space station]]'s [[hangar]]. Pava soon learned that O-R10N had not survived the mission. After BB-8 transmitted back the control codes for the prison to Luta, Pava and her fellow pilots and Grakkus prepared to jump into [[hyperspace]]. However, Terex had escaped Megalox in his starship ''[[Carrion Spike]]'' and launched an attack on the station. At Temmin's urging, Black Squadron turned back and bombarded the ''Carrion Spike'', stopping Terex from destroying the station's shuttles and allowing Luta to attend to the [[prisoner]]s. The squadron returned to D'Qar where Organa instructed Dameron to delay their search for San Tekka in order to investigate whether the First Order had a [[spy]] within the Resistance.<ref name="PD6" />

====Comrades in arms====
Due to the presence of a spy, Poe found himself unable to trust his fellow Black Squadron pilots including Jess Pava. He did not bring them along during his solo [[Skirmish on Pheryon|missions]] to [[Pheryon]]<ref name="PD7">[[Poe Dameron 7|''Poe Dameron'' 7]]</ref> and [[Kaddak]]. During the [[Mission to Kaddak|Kaddak mission]] to recover a [[Resistance spy droid network|Resistance droid spy]] who had purportedly obtained valuable intelligence on the First Order, Poe brought BB-8, C-3PO, and the technician Oddy Muva along instead, choosing to leave Jess and the other pilots at the Resistance base on D'Qar.<ref name="PD8">[[Poe Dameron 8|''Poe Dameron'' 8]]</ref> Unknown to them, Oddy Muva had been blackmailed by Terex into becoming a First Order spy.<ref name="PD11">[[Poe Dameron 11|''Poe Dameron'' 11]]</ref> Terex had taken his wife [[Sowa Chuan]] hostage to ensure his compliance.<ref name="PD12">[[Poe Dameron 12|''Poe Dameron'' 12]]</ref>

[[File:JessikaPavaBB8-PoeDameron25.png|thumb|right|250px|Pava and BB-8]]
Later, Jessika and her fellow Black Squadron pilots flew to a [[Unidentified desert planet|desert planet]] to rescue Poe and the droids, who had been pursued there by Terex and the [[Ranc Gang]].<ref name="PD12" /> Upon arriving, Jess remarked there were too many "[[Ugly|Uglies]]" which would make it hard for them to rescue Poe. Temmin reassured her that they could do it since their opponents were leftovers made from discarded Rebel and [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] technology. During the dogfight, Jess expressed surprise when Terex's flagship ''Carrion Spike'' suddenly opened fire on the Ranc Gang's "Uglies." After learning that Oddy had evacuated the slaves and sabotaged the ''Carrion Spike''{{'s}} computers, Jess and the rest of Black Squadron escorted the escape pods.<ref name="PD13">[[Poe Dameron 13|''Poe Dameron'' 13]]</ref>

Despite their best efforts, one of the escape pods was destroyed and L'ulo was killed in combat. After the escape pods had entered the desert planet's atmosphere, Jess and her fellow pilots regrouped for an attack on the ''Carrion Spike'' and the remaining "Uglies." Shortly later, a First Order Maxima-A class heavy cruiser exited hyperspace and began destroying Terex's fleet. Jess and her comrades expressed surprise, not knowing that Terex had embarked on an unsanctioned mission against the First Order's directives. Jess and her fellow pilots flew over Poe and a First Order landing party led by [[Commander]] [[Malarus]] to ensure that hostilities did not take place. Fortunately for the Resistance, Malarus was only interested in apprehending Terex.<ref name="PD13" />

====Low on supplies====
Pava and the rest of Black Squadron then went on a mission to obtain critically needed fuel supplies by meeting with the freighter ''[[Romary]]''.<ref name="Poe Dameron 16" />

====War stories====
[[File:BTLS3-PoeDameron17.png|thumb|left|200px|Pava and Javos in an old BTL-S3 Y-wing]]
The Squadron's next mission had them split up, with Kun flying escort for Pava and the journalist/agent [[Suralinda Javos]] to [[Spalex]] aboard a [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter|BTL-S3 Y-wing Starfighter]].<ref name="Poe Dameron 17" /> Once there, they witnessed First Order troops harassing the [[Spalexian|natives]]. Kun and Pava intervened, but were captured. Javos managed to free them, and they reunited with Dameron and Wexley, who had escaped the First Order with the help of Muva.<ref name="Poe Dameron 19">[[Poe Dameron 19|''Poe Dameron'' 19]]</ref>

====Legend found====
Back at base, Pava had to deal with the fact that among the Resistance astromech droids, she was known as the "Great Destroyer" for losing so many droids. [[Zari Bangel]] tried to change that, but the droids ran away when distracted. Then, the Resistance got a lead on their search for San Tekka.<ref name="Poe Dameron 20">[[Poe Dameron 20|''Poe Dameron'' 20]]</ref>

Shortly afterward, as Pava tried to install a stand-alone navicomputer aboard her X-wing, [[Ivee]] agreed to fly with her.<ref name="Poe Dameron 21">[[Poe Dameron 21|''Poe Dameron'' 21]]</ref> They then departed to [[Cato Neimoidia]] to retrieve San Tekka, where as a distraction Black Squadron engaged in a lengthy dogfight with [[Baron]] [[Paw Maccon]]'s droid starfighters. However, agents Terex and Malarus abducted San Tekka from them.<ref name="Poe Dameron 22">[[Poe Dameron 22|''Poe Dameron'' 22]]</ref>

Later, the squadron rendezvoused at the [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']], where they were given orders to launch at a moment's notice to recover San Tekka. Pava ran a mathematical simulation to tell when Terex's vessel may run out of fuel in hyperspace, leading her to deduce that the tracker aboard had been discovered or destroyed.<ref name="Poe Dameron 24">[[Poe Dameron 24|''Poe Dameron'' 24]]</ref>

Once Terex dropped a line to the Resistance informing them of San Tekka's location in the [[Great Forveen Nebula]], Black Squadron is deployed. Dameron led the team on a strike on the [[Unidentified First Order Light Cruiser|light cruiser]], where it was destroyed. However, a shot hit and disabled Pava's X-wing, crippling it and leaving it vulnerable to an incoming [[concussion missile]]. Ivee sacrificed herself to save Pava, telling her it is was not her fault.<ref name="Poe Dameron 25">[[Poe Dameron 25|''Poe Dameron'' 25]]</ref>

After recovering San Tekka, they returned to D'Qar for [[Snap and Karé's wedding]]. Pava comforted BB-8, having found a [[processor]] left behind by Ivee.<ref name="Poe Dameron 25" />

===First Order–Resistance war===
====Battle of Takodana====
After the Resistance spy droid [[GA-97]] reported that Dameron's missing droid, [[BB-8]], had been spotted at [[Maz Kanata]]'s [[Takodana Castle|castle]] on [[Takodana]], Pava flew as Blue Three when both Blue and [[Red Squadron (Galactic Alliance)|Red Squadron]] fought under Dameron's command. During the [[Battle of Takodana]], the First Order was forced to retreat, but only after they had destroyed the castle and captured [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]].<ref name="Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref>

====Battle of Starkiller Base====
[[File:Fly_Jessika_fly.png|thumb|right|250px|Pava during the Battle of Starkiller Base]]
When the First Order targeted the Resistance base with the [[Starkiller Base|Starkiller]], a planet-destroying [[superweapon]], Pava, along with numerous Resistance pilots, [[Battle of Starkiller Base|engaged]] the First Order's forces in an attempt to destroy the weapon. During Dameron's run on the base's [[thermal oscillator]], Pava provided him with cover. After Dameron successfully crippled the system, destroying the Starkiller, Pava and the other surviving pilots returned to their base and celebrated.<ref name="VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref> Her astromech droid copilot during the battle was [[R0-4L0]].

====Gathering allies====
Following the battle, Organa sent Pava and several other pilots, including Wexley, to gather the New Republic's surviving commanders, after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]] had wiped out most of the New Republic's [[fleet]].<ref name="TLJNovel">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]''</ref> They departed while the rest of the Resistance was [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuating]] the base.<ref name="PD28">[[Poe Dameron 28|''Poe Dameron'' 28]]</ref> She flew with the astromech droid [[6G-66]]. She recorded a message that was transmitted by a com sat and picked up by the surviving Resistance fighters aboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. Their first mission was to [[Pastoria]], where they failed to convince King [[Siroc]] to aid their cause.<ref name="PD29">[[Poe Dameron 29|''Poe Dameron'' 29]]</ref>

Their next stop was at [[Ikkrukk]], where the Squadron responded to the distress call. Pava crashed trying to get through the city's shields.<ref name="PD30" /> They were then trapped by [[Ikkrukk First Order sympathizers]], but Pava and Javos managed to rendezvous with [[Grist]] and restore the city defenses in the [[Battle of Ikkrukk]].<ref name="PD31">[[Poe Dameron 31|''Poe Dameron'' 31]]</ref>

On [[Rattatak]], Pava and Javos recruited [[Teza Nasz]] to the Resistance and then rendezvoused on Ryloth with the rest of Black Squadron.<ref name="Star Wars Encyclopedia" />

====Battle of Exegol====
Pava flew at the [[Battle of Exegol]]. After the battle, she and other surviving members of Black Squadron mourned the loss of Snap Wexley.<ref name="Star Wars Encyclopedia" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:JessPavaCardTrader.png|thumb|left|150px|Jessika Pava, a dedicated member of the Resistance.]]
Jessika Pava was a human female with black [[hair]] and light skin. She was a dedicated member of the Resistance and an admirer of Luke Skywalker, having heard that he was the best [[star]] pilot in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Weapon of a Jedi" /> Jessika was a trusted and loyal friend of Poe Dameron, earning her a place in his Black Squadron.<ref name="PD1" /> She was a skilled and competent starfighter pilot.<ref name="PD3" /> Jess also knew how to wield a [[blaster]].<ref name="PD4" /> Pava was not used to fighting without any weapons or a starship. She also did not like being unable to control her fate and surroundings,<ref name="PD5" /> given her history of being captured by pirates.<ref name="Poe Dameron 16" /> Still, Pava held herself well against a mob of criminals hired by Terex on Megalox Beta.<ref name="PD5" />

[[File:Jess_Pava_T-70_XWM.png|thumb|right|200px|Pava's T-70 X-wing fighter]]
Pava's loyalty to Poe led her and her fellow Black Squadron pilots to travel to a desert planet to rescue him. She was initially daunted by Terex's swarm of "Uglies" until Temmin reassured her they could beat the "junk" fighters. Jess was affected by L'ulo's death and vowed revenge against Terex's Ranc Gang.<ref name="PD13" />

She took L'ulo's death hard, and it was Dameron's inspired speech about how they were luminous beings that helped her deal with it.<ref name="Poe Dameron 14">[[Poe Dameron 14|''Poe Dameron'' 14]]</ref> Pava also developed a reputation among the base's astromech droid pool where she was known as "the great destroyer,"<ref name="Poe Dameron 16" /> causing them to avoid flying with her.<ref name="Poe Dameron 17" /> When Pava set out to pick a new astromech droid for her [[T-70 X-wing starfighter|X-wing]], every member of the astromech droid pool fled at the sight of her, except for [[BB-8]], who held up his lighter in a gesture that Pava had a feeling was meant to be less than friendly.<ref name="Poe Dameron 20" />

==Equipment==
Jessika Pava wore a [[flight helmet]] that read "NAO" in [[Aurebesh]].<ref name="VII" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I was auditioning for a different character, actually, so I spent six months auditioning for that character. And then, at the end, J.J. said, "I want you to be in the film, but I want to write a character for you." That's how Jess Pava was created.|Jessica Henwick on her ''Star Wars'' Audition|<ref name="Audition">{{WebCite|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/heat-vision/underwater-jessica-henwick-had-6-month-star-wars-audition-rey-1268648|text=Jessica Henwick on 'Underwater' and Her 6-Month 'Star Wars' Audition|author=Davids, Brian|date=2020-01-10|work=''[[Wikipedia:The Hollywood Reporter|The Hollywood Reporter]]''|quote="I was auditioning for a different character, actually, so I spent six months auditioning for that character. And then, at the end, J.J. said, "I want you to be in the film, but I want to write a character for you." That's how Jess Pava was created. So, it was a very, very long experience. It's hard because I've been doing this long enough to know that you go in, audition, put it to the back of your mind, don't think about it and don't get emotionally invested. But, after six months, you can't help but just desperately want it. I'm also such a big J.J. fan. So, I was a mess at the end of those six months. [Editor's Note: Henwick was a finalist for Rey.]"|archivedate=20200229030402}}</ref>}}
Jessika Pava first appeared in the [[2015]] novel ''[[The Weapon of a Jedi: A Luke Skywalker Adventure]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Weapon of a Jedi" /> In [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], she was portrayed by [[Jessica Henwick]].<ref name="VII" /> Henwick was a finalist for the role of [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] in ''The Force Awakens'', and auditioned for six months. Although she ultimately was not cast in the role, director [[J.J. Abrams]] wanted to use her in the movie and wrote the character of Jessika Pava specifically for her.<ref name="Audition" /> The actress expressed interest in reprising the role for the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="Suiting up">{{WebCite|url=http://abcnewsradioonline.com/entertainment-news/iron-fist-star-jessica-henwick-waiting-to-suit-back-up-for-j.html|text='Iron Fist' star Jessica Henwick waiting to suit back up for J.J. Abrams in 'Star Wars: Episode IX'|date=2018-09-19|quote=With 2019's ''Star Wars: Episode IX'' underway, Henwick tells ABC Radio she's ready to jump back in the cockpit. "I really, really want to be on the last one but I haven't had the call yet! I don't know what's happening! J.J., come on!"|archivedate=20191229212211}}</ref> but the character did not make an appearance in the film.<ref name="IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

The decals on the [[Resistance pilot]] [[flight helmet]]s were designed by costume designer and concept artist [[Glyn Dillon]].<ref name="Dillon">{{Instagram|username=glyn__dillon|url=p/BZo-wgJh8LL|name=[[Glyn Dillon]]|date=September 29, 2017|quote=Back on The Force Awakens I came up with the decals for the rebel helmets (which is why my two boys are on Poe's helmet).|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/TeQlp}}</ref> The name inscribed on Pava's helmet, Nao,<ref name="VII" /> is a reference to the main character of<ref name="Nao">{{Instagram|username=glyn__dillon|url=p/Cinmavpr9F7|name=[[Glyn Dillon]]|date=2022-09-17|quote=Ten years ago today The Nao of Brown came out. If you still haven't got a copy, it's about time.!|archivefile=File:Instagram_Glyn_Dillon.png}}</ref> Dillon's [[2012]] graphic novel ''The Nao of Brown''.<ref name="NAO">{{WebCite|url=https://www.theguardian.com/books/2012/nov/22/nao-of-brown-glyn-dillon-review|text=The Nao of Brown by Glyn Dillon – review|author=Alderman, Naomi|date=2012-11-22|work=''[[Wikipedia:The Guardian|The Guardian]]''|quote=Nao is a charming half-Japanese woman with a bob and cute shoes, who works in a shop selling Japanese ephemera.|archivedate=20220524115511}}</ref>
